cs.t: Never again. I was a Thinkpad loyalist, and used it exclusively for 12 years. Last year I got a new one and the screen backlight died within 5 months. Lenovo shat on the brand, and I'm not going back. After sampling a few different products, I got myself a $400(!) Asus X501A. Beautiful piece. Light as a feather. And has 3x the battery life of my Thinkpad.
